messages:
maria gomez: Quick note 1:15 1 saw p99 spike on the merged endpoint latency tile for /v1/embeddings. p50/p95 flat. Anyone else seeing this?
kevin: I see it. When I split by region the spike disappears. Looks like the merged view is accumulating something.
jonas: Possible duplicate samples from retries/fanout. Merging t-digests across routes will treat duplicates as independent which inflates upper quantiles.
zara: do samples include request_id? if yes, we should let queries dedupe by request_id.
maria gomez: yes. Quick dump: `curl telemetry.internal/samples?endpoint=/v1/embeddings&from=1748200000&to=1748200300` shows repeated request_id with different replica/retry fields.
kevin: API decision: do we add `?dedupe=request_id` or perform automatic dedupe for merged endpoint views?
jonas: prefer query-time opt-in. Ingest dedupe rewrites history and surprises customers. Also cheaper to experiment with query transforms.
azara: UX: console should indicate aggregation provenance. Idea: a small pill next to the metric: `provenance: merged (dedupe=request_id)` and on hover show the transform chain and a link to run raw vs deduped side-by-side.
alex: agree. Also add `aggregation_mode=(raw|tdigest|deduped)` and `dedupe_by=(none|request_id|session_id)` to the Metrics API. Console can set defaults for merged endpoint views.
maria gomez: quick perf numbers I ran locally: dedupe-by-request_id grouping adds ~10% CPU and ~90ms for a 200k-sample query; added results to the PR draft.
kevin: good to include. Tests: we need a synthetic harness that injects duplicated high-latency samples and verifies p99 collapses when `dedupe=request_id`. Also define deterministic tie-breaker (choose min latency per request_id) so SLOs are conservative.
jonas: will add merge-path unit tests and a regression to prevent double-counting on t-digest merges.
azara: console UX: per-tenant default toggle in Settings -> Telemetry, and an inline banner on dashboards when `dedupe` changes numbers >5% compared to raw. Also a one-click "show raw" toggle.
sre-bot: :rotating_light: alert: route=/v1/embeddings p99 +31% vs baseline, samples=4120
maria gomez: opened PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/1912 adds `dedupe_by` param + provenance header and a console flag to enable dedupe for merged views.
alex: next steps: (1) land API param default off, (2) console enable by default for merged endpoint tiles with visible provenance and a tooltip, (3) run staging canary across a sample of tenants for 72h and produce a delta report, (4) publish changelog + docs.
kevin: I'll draft the changelog and delta-report endpoint to let customers compare historical raw vs deduped numbers.
jonas: will add tests and perf harness.
azara: I'll prototype the provenance pill and the "show raw" toggle.
maria gomez: scheduling staging canary for telemetry service tomorrow AM. PR contains benchmarks and tie-breaker policy.
sre-bot: :white_check_mark: telemetry staging deploy succeeded at 1748201800
alex: thanks all  let's iterate after canary results.
